releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.13.3 - Acoustic Silence & Thermal Lock Fix:
- Fixed ThermalShield resetting CPU to 100% boost upon deactivation (preserves TempTamer 99% cool lock).
- Lowered baseline gaming floor to 34% PWM (~2,200 RPM) to eliminate loud fan screaming during light gaming/idle.
- Smooth rate-limited fan ramps (+2% / -1%) for completely seamless acoustic transitions.
- Maintained whisper idle floor (~1,750 RPM) and full EcoQoS background throttling.
